card.title: PS5 +1.0V Vcore VRM Short Isolation via Coil Lifting & NCP252160

claims.statement: A shorted MOSFET on the +1.0V Vcore circuit can be isolated by lifting output coils and measuring input versus output.
claims.evidence: Lifting the main output coils separates the APU load from the VRM MOSFET drivers.
claims.quote: To find shorted mosfet isolate Vcore circuit by lifting the output coils and measuring input and output

procedure: Lift the Vcore output coils to separate the VRM driver side from the APU side.
Measure input and output rails relative to ground to determine if the short lies on the APU side or the VRM MOSFET driver side.
card.caveats: Lifting coils isolates whether the short is on the power generation side or the APU side, but does not identify individual failed MOSFETs without further probing.
